summary: Implemented the Jupyter utilities feature. Added monai/utils/jupyter_utils.py with to_2d_display_array() and ipython_imshow() (matplotlib and IPython imported lazily to avoid circular imports), tests/test_jupyter_utils.py, and a Jupyter utilities section in docs/source/utils.rst. Ran tests.test_jupyter_utils with the prepared venv: 8 tests, OK, 1 skipped because matplotlib is not installed in that venv, so the plotting path is unverified. flake8 is not installed in the venv, so lint was not run. Nothing was committed and no packages were installed. The API names are my own choice since the spec gives none; I can rename them if upstream differs.
